rows.name: Mars Project Brazil 2026
rows.jobDuty:
Your responsibilities will evolve across business areas, and may include:

- Drive merchant acquisition, activation, and retention strategies to grow Keeta's supply-side ecosystem in Brazil.

- Design and execute consumer growth and retention initiatives, tailoring strategies to local user behavior and market dynamics.

- Optimize delivery operations — improving efficiency, rider experience, and fulfillment quality in the Brazilian market.

- Conduct business analysis to translate data into strategic insights, supporting key decisions across functions.

- Lead or contribute to cross-functional projects, collaborating with local and global teams to solve real business challenges.
rows.jobRequirement:
- Education: Full-time international MBA required. We seek candidates who have completed or are completing a full-time MBA program, bringing a global perspective and the academic foundation to lead in a complex, fast-growing market.

- Background: Experience in consulting, finance, tech, fast-moving consumer goods, or management trainee programs is a strong fit. Candidates from outside the industry with demonstrated high potential are equally welcome.

- Language: Fluent in Portuguese and English.

- Mindset: Humble, hands-on, curious, resilient — excited by the ambiguity of building something from scratch, not just managing what's already there.
rows.highLight:
About Mars Program
Mars Program is Keeta's flagship leadership accelerator — a strategic investment in the next generation of business leaders for Brazil. This is not a traditional hire. We are looking for high-potential talents who want to build a long-term career in Brazil, understand the food delivery business end-to-end, and grow into future leaders of this organization.

You will be assigned to one of the four core pillars of our business — Merchant, Consumer, Delivery, and Business Analytics — gaining a comprehensive, hands-on understanding of what it takes to build and scale a world-class food delivery platform.

Why Join 
- High Starting Point — a dual recognition of your past achievements and future potential. 
- End-to-End Business Exposure — specialize in one of our four core pillars. Build the holistic view and foundational logic of the food delivery business.
- Executive Mentorship & Visibility — Enter a high-visibility talent pool with direct access to senior leadership, intensive coaching, and exposure to strategic decisions.

Work Location: São Paulo, Brazil.
Onboarding Target: September 2026

rows.name: Beauty Category Manager
rows.jobDuty:
Responsible to develop the overall strategy for a product category and research new product opportunities within the category to drive sale and achieve set targets.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES AND TASKS:
- Analyze data to determine industry and consumer trends.
- Identify and establish long-term partnerships with direct distributors and salers.
- Stay on the lookout for new suppliers based on strategy.
- Assist in setting the yearly budget/sale target and profit per category.
- Administer the price setting and respect the margin per category.
- Monitor and enhance category/product performance.
- Establish long-term development strategies for product categories.
- Develop exit strategies for unsuccessful products.
- Create trust relationships with vendors to achieve better pricing and quality of services.
- Determine the positioning of a product category to maximize visibility.
Monitor price and competition.
- Collaborate with buyers and merchandisers to expand product categories.
Assume responsibility of budget development and revenue for category.

Minimum Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration or Marketing or equivalent.
